label: Weekly focus check
h1: Measure your focus weekly, then experiment

items.b:
Pick one experiment for the next two weeks and compare your weekly focus scores:
• no phone for the first 30 minutes after waking
• a 10-minute walk before deep work
• notifications off for work hours

Change one thing at a time so you can tell what helped.

Same time, same quiet place, once a week. Take your focus test or baseline now. Comparing like with like week to week matters more than any single score.

Note anything that might affect it: sleep last night, caffeine, stress.
